usefulness.rationale: The reader learns only that Anders Danielsson is Skanska's President and CEO and presented the 2025 year-end report on 6 Feb 2026, both backed by a single press invitation. No education, career history, or personal detail appears in the dossier body (identity anchors are asserted data, not sourced claims). Nothing signals what is unknown, so it risks implying completeness; and a reader could not meaningfully prepare for a meeting beyond knowing his title and one recent public appearance. The three unjustified conclusions (Migration Agency role, company-scale personal figures, 2026 employer award) do not appear in any dossier statement, so no overclaims can be matched to them.
